tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.legs: Four braced legs with a foot each. With them fitted the whole pod comes down; without, only the cabin does, under a chute, and the pod must be mended.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.hold: Nine slots a row (rows by the pod's class). Use the pod's base with an empty hand to open it.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.seat: A seat beside the pilot's. Someone can ride along.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.extra_ta: The pod holds half as much fuel again.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.kick_sta: A second burn on the way out: every trip costs a fifth less fuel.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.scanner: After a landing, a needle on the action bar points to the nearest settlement or mission site.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.ki_canno: A cannon on the hull, for the pod's flights. Forged.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.shield: A shield for the pod's flights. Forged.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.mining_b: A beam for cutting rock from the pod. Forged.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.tow_line: A line and hook for hauling. Forged.
tooltip.jaymospowers.pod_module.fit: Use it on a pod's bay (low on the hull) to fit it. Sneak with an empty hand there to take one out.
item.jaymospowers.stardust.tooltip: A pinch of a falling star. A stargazer or a Patrol officer will trade a hint for it.
item.jaymospowers.return_stage.tooltip: Lifting off from a far world takes one. Pack it in the pod's hold or your own pack.
message.jaymospowers.pod.sockets_full: All %1$s sockets are taken. Sneak with an empty hand to take one out.
message.jaymospowers.pod.no_legs: No legs under her: the cabin came down alone under a chute. The tank, the fins and the mast tore away. She must be mended.
message.jaymospowers.pod.no_legs_bare: No legs under her: the cabin came down alone under a chute. She must be mended.
message.jaymospowers.space_no_stage: Lifting off from here takes a return stage, packed in the hold or your pack.
message.jaymospowers.stardust.caught: A falling star. A pinch of its dust in the bottle.
message.jaymospowers.scope.found: %1$s: its light is in the glass. It goes on the pod's map.
message.jaymospowers.beacon.lit: The beacon is lit (%1$s of %2$s). The pod will come down beside it.
message.jaymospowers.beacon.unlit: Light it first, with flint and steel or a fire charge.
message.jaymospowers.fuel_works.empty: No cans yet. Feed it coal: %1$s to a can.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_space.back_: The tank is too small: %1$s there and back
talk.jaymospowers.patrol.opt.stardust: Trade a pinch of stardust for a hint
talk.jaymospowers.stardust.none: No dust, no hint. Catch a falling star in a glass bottle and bring it to me.
talk.jaymospowers.stardust.known_all: You have read every light I know of. The sky holds no more for you.
talk.jaymospowers.stardust.hint: Look for a %1$s. It stands highest in the %2$s, %3$s over the horizon, %4$s.
talk.jaymospowers.stardust.hint_below: %1$s sits under the world this season, out of sight. Watch another night.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.title: Pilot's Logbook
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.next_none: Nothing is left to ask of her. Go where you like.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.keel: Set a keel down. Every pod starts as a frame.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.built: Built her whole: fins, bell, tank, plates, canopy, mast.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.charted: Read a star chart. A world is on the map.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.landed: Landed on a world not my own.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.fitted: Fitted a module to her sockets.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.scoped: Held a world's light in the glass until it was recorded.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.dust: Caught a falling star's dust in a bottle.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.beacon: Lit a landing beacon at home.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.crashed: Came down without legs. Mend her before she flies.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.next.built: Next: finish the pod. A hammer closes the last seam.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.next.fueled: Next: fuel the tank (coal, blaze powder, cans).
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.next.charted: Next: find a world's light. Read a star chart, or watch the night through a telescope.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.next.launched: Next: open the star map and lift off.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.next.landed: Next: set her down on the world.
book.jaymospowers.pod_log.next.returned: Next: pack a return stage and fuel, and come home.
jei.jaymospowers.fuel_works.how: Put coal in the works (a hopper will do). Take the cans out with an empty hand.
jei.jaymospowers.fuel_works.hoppers: Blaze powder stays the rich fuel; a can is plain fuel.
jei.jaymospowers.stardust.how: Hold a glass bottle and watch a falling star come down.
jei.jaymospowers.stardust.trade: A stargazer or a Patrol officer trades a hint of the sky for a pinch.
